edition.en: Poems of Gerard Manley Hopkins (1918), edited by Robert Bridges, from the scan-backed transcription on Wikisource; the editor’s notes omitted
edition.zh: 据维基文库依扫描本校录的《霍普金斯诗集》（1918），罗伯特·布里奇斯编；略去编者注

basis.en: Written in 1877 and first published in 1918; the author died in 1889 and the editor in 1930.
basis.zh: 1877 年写成，1918 年首次出版；作者卒于 1889 年，编者卒于 1930 年。

note.en: Hopkins called this a “curtal sonnet”, a shortened one; like almost all his poems it waited until Robert Bridges published them in 1918, nearly thirty years after his death. It praises things that are dappled, patched, freckled and odd, including the gear and tackle of every trade. The accents on “áll trádes” are Hopkins’s own marks for stress.
note.zh: 霍普金斯称它为“截短的十四行诗”；和他几乎所有的诗一样，它一直等到 1918 年才由罗伯特·布里奇斯出版，那时距他去世已近三十年。诗赞美一切斑驳、拼补、生着雀斑和古怪的东西，连各行各业的工具和装备也在其中。“áll trádes”上的重音符号是霍普金斯自己标的。

excerpt.orig: All things counter, original, spare, strange;
excerpt.en: All things counter, original, spare, strange;
excerpt.zh: 一切相反的、新奇的、稀少的、古怪的事物；
